```{python}
# Setup code
import pandas as pd
from python_scripts import setup
from python_scripts import services
from python_scripts import helper
df, dffp = setup.setup(verbose=False)

from python_scripts import distinct_pathways
dpw_pls = distinct_pathways.get_distinct_pathways_routes(dffp)
qrows = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] == "[Not ended or invalid end reason]"
dpw_pls.loc[dpw_pls.pl_end_dt > distinct_pathways.dpw_end_dt, ["pl_end_dt", "pl_end_reason"]] = pd.NA
dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls.loc[qrows, "pl_end_dt"].isna().map({True: "[Not ended]", False: "Missing data/error"})
dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"] = dpw_pls["rt_end_cat"].str.replace("To care/hosp.", "To care/hospital")
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers

import matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    'figure.figsize': (6.2, 4.1),
    'font.size': 12,
    'figure.constrained_layout.use': True
})

asset_themes = {"opaque": "assets_output/",
                "transparent_lightbg": "assets_transparent_lightbg/",
                "transparent_darkbg": "assets_transparent_darkbg/"}
assets_output = asset_themes["opaque"]
output_dir = assets_output
transparent = False
excel_output = {}


def get_frequencies(series, sort=True, dropna=True, dropna_pct=True):
    n = series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=dropna).rename("n")
    pct = 100 * series.value_counts(sort=sort, dropna=(dropna or dropna_pct), normalize=True).rename("pct")
    fq_tbl = pd.concat([n, pct], axis=1)
    return fq_tbl


dpw_pls_orig = dpw_pls
```

## Generated tables for each characteristic of interest
```{python}
#| output: asis
from collections import defaultdict
dpw_pls = dpw_pls_orig
# Age category at year of first route during studied period
dpw_pls["gender"] = dpw_pls["gender"].map({
    "Male": "Male", "Female": "Female", "Don't Know": "_Unknown",
    "Prefer not to say": "_Unknown", "Transgender": "Non-Binary",
    "Non-Binary": "Non-Binary"
})
dpw_pls["age_cat"] = helper.age_cats(dpw_pls["pl_start_dt"].dt.year - dpw_pls["yob"])
dpw_pls["global_majority"] = dpw_pls["ethnicity"].map(defaultdict(
    lambda: "Yes",
    {
      "English/Welsh/Scottish/Northern Irish/British": "No", "White British": "No",
      "White Other Origin": "No", "Any other White background": "No", "White European": "No",
      "Eastern European": "No", "Turkish": "No", "White Irish": "No", "Irish": "No",
      "White Gypsy/Irish Traveller": "No", "Gypsy (inc English, Scottish or Roma Gypsy) or Irish Traveller": "No",
      "Don't know": "_Unknown", "Prefer not to say": "_Unknown", "Refused to answer question": "_Unknown"
    }))
dpw_pls["lgbtq_plus"] = dpw_pls["sexual_orientation"].map({
    "Bi-sexual": "Yes", "Gay/Lesbian": "Yes", "other": "Yes", "Lesbian": "Yes",
    "Heterosexual": "No", "Don't Know": "_Unknown", "Rather not state": "_Unknown",
})
dpw_pls["uk_immigration_status"] = dpw_pls["uk_immigration_status"].map({
    "Other Protection Leave to Remain": "Non-EEA National",
    "Indefinite Leave to Remain": "Non-EEA National",
    "Other Non-EEA National": "Non-EEA National",
    "Limited Leave to Remain": "Non-EEA National",
    "EEA National": "EEA National",
    "UK/Irish National": "UK/Irish National",
})
ref_cats = dpw_pls["ref_agency"].cat.categories
ref_cat_map = {
    "Local authority (Housing Options)": ["B.C.C. Homelessness Prevention Team"],
    "Local authority (_other)": list(ref_cats[ref_cats.str.startswith(("B.C.C", "Bcc"))
                                    & (ref_cats != "B.C.C. Homelessness Prevention Team")]),
    "Service provider (rough sleeping and SH)": ["St. Mungo's", "St Mungo's", "Outreach"],
    "Service provider (prison resettlement and SH)": ["A.R.A"],
    "Service provider (_other SH)": ["E.C.H.G. Riverside", "Elim", "Livewest", "Missing Link", "Places For People",
                                    "Salvation Army", "Second Step", "Self Help"]
}
ref_cat_map["_Others"] = ref_cats[~ref_cats.isin(sum(list(ref_cat_map.values()), []))]
ref_agency_mapper = {k: v for v, k in pd.Series(ref_cat_map).explode().items()}
dpw_pls["referral_agency"] = (dpw_pls["ref_agency"].map(ref_agency_mapper)
                              .fillna("_[Missing data]"))
support_need_cols = {
    "hsn_prison_leaveron_probationrisk_of_offending": "offending",
    "hsn_physical_health": "physical_health",
    "hsn_mental_health": "mental_health",
    "hsn_rough_sleeper": "rough_sleeping",
}
for hsn, ch_str in support_need_cols.items():
    dpw_pls[ch_str] = dpw_pls[hsn].astype("boolean")
gendered_support_need_cols = {
    "hsn_sex_working": "sex_working",  # only women recorded as sex working
    "hsn_risk_of_violenceabuse_victim": "risk_violence_abuse",
    "hsn_risk_of_exploitation": "risk_exploitation",
}
for hsn, ch_str in gendered_support_need_cols.items():
    dpw_pls[f"women_{ch_str}"] = dpw_pls[hsn].where(dpw_pls["gender"] == "Female")
    dpw_pls[f"men_{ch_str}"] = dpw_pls[hsn].where(dpw_pls["gender"] == "Male")
    dpw_pls[ch_str] = dpw_pls[hsn]
dpw_pls["hsn_drug_or_alcohol_use"] = (dpw_pls["hsn_drug_use"].astype("boolean")
                                      | dpw_pls["hsn_alcohol_use"].astype("boolean"))
dpw_pls["multiple_disadvantage"] = (  # Current support needs for 3 out of 5 SMD dimensions
  dpw_pls[["hsn_prison_leaveron_probationrisk_of_offending",
           "hsn_drug_or_alcohol_use",
           "hsn_risk_of_violenceabuse_victim",
           "hsn_mental_health"
           ]].assign(hsn_homelessness=True).astype("boolean").sum(axis=1, skipna=False) >= 3
  )
dpw_pls["substance_use"] = dpw_pls["hsn_drug_or_alcohol_use"]
dpw_rt_starts = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").head(1)
dpw_rt_ends = dpw_pls.groupby("route_id").tail(1)
dpw_clis = dpw_pls.groupby(["o_cli_id"]).head(1)  # 1 duplicate client but first entry has more detailed answers
for ch in [
    "gender",
    "global_majority",
    "age_cat",
    "lgbtq_plus",
    "offending",
    "physical_health",
    "mental_health",
    "substance_use",
    "multiple_disadvantage",
    "rough_sleeping",
    "sex_working",
    "women_sex_working",
    "men_sex_working",
    "risk_violence_abuse",
    "women_risk_violence_abuse",
    "men_risk_violence_abuse",
    "risk_exploitation",
    "women_risk_exploitation",
    "men_risk_exploitation",
    "uk_immigration_status",
    "english_2nd_language",
    "referral_agency"
]:
    tbl_desc = f"Frequencies for {ch}"
    tbl = get_frequencies(dpw_clis[ch], sort=False, dropna=False)
    excel_output[tbl_desc] = tbl
    if ch != "age_cat":
        tbl = tbl.sort_index()
    tbl.index = tbl.index.astype("object").fillna("<NA>")
    print("### " + tbl_desc)
    with pd.option_context("display.float_format", '{:,.1f}'.format):
        display(tbl)
    print("")
```

## Tables in an Excel file

```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
sheetname = "Sheet1"
qmdfile = os.getenv("QUARTO_DOCUMENT_FILE")
filename = assets_output + qmdfile[:-4]+".xlsx"
with pd.ExcelWriter(filename) as writer:
    next_row = 0
    for k, v in excel_output.items():
        pd.DataFrame([k]).to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, header=False, index=False, startrow=next_row)
        next_row += 1
        v.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheetname, startrow=next_row, float_format="%.1f")
        next_row += (
            (1 if not isinstance(v.columns, pd.MultiIndex) else 1 + len(v.columns.levels))
            + len(v) + 1)
print(f"[Excel file](./{filename})")
```
